Nina (AE): Quick ask - MediVault wants a hosted POC burst next Tue 14:00-15:30 PDT. They request a temporary scoped key, IP allowlist, and a quota bump to 420 qps for 90 minutes. They also want an abort button and a hard spend cap.
Ethan (Sales Eng): Do we have their org id and typical tokens per response? Any compliance concerns?
Nina (AE): Org: org_medivault_9. Avg payload ~30 tokens, but expect spikes. No extra compliance beyond allowlist. Customer contact is lucy@medivault.com. They requested key rotation ability.
Priya (Platform Eng): 420 qps is high but we can do a temporary exception. Need exact epoch start/end, CIDR(s), and a ramp plan. Suggest 0 -> 100 -> 220 -> 320 -> 420 over 10 minute steps. We'll attach a p95 latency fallback at 160ms.
Nina (AE): CIDRs: 198.51.100.0/24. Also single IP 203.0.113.45/32. Start epoch: 1917010800, end: 1917016200. Customer agrees to a $600 hard cap and can abort anytime.
Kai (SRE): I'll require a formal ticket with those epochs and the approver. I'll enable synthetic probes and an automatic throttle policy: if error rate >1.5% for 5m or p95>160ms for 3m then drop to 125 qps. Who will own runbook?
Ethan (Sales Eng): Sales will own runbook; I can produce the step-by-step playbook and customer-facing instructions including abort contact.
Priya (Platform Eng): I'll create scoped role scoped:poc_medivault and make the key ephemeral with expiry==end. Sample usage for the customer:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <SCOOPED_POC_KEY>\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-beta-2","prompt":"health check","max_tokens":64}'
```
Priya (Platform Eng): Client best practices: respect 429 headers, use exponential backoff + jitter, include X-Org header, and prefer keep-alive connections to reduce TLS overhead.
quota-bot: Quota exception request Q-8457 received for org_medivault_9.
quota-bot: Quota exception approved: +360 qps (total 420 qps) for scoped key scoped:poc_medivault. Window: 1917010800 -> 1917016200. Request ID: Q-8457. Approver: infra-ops.
Kai (SRE): Exception applied, dashboards live. I'll monitor latency, error-rate, and GPU queue depth during the window and will post alerts here. I'll flip the fallback throttle if thresholds hit and notify the thread.
Nina (AE): Please DM the key to me when ready. Also provide rotation steps and an abort contact number.
Priya (Platform Eng): Key is created and DM'd to Nina. Rotation endpoint example and minimal runbook posted to customer's email.
Ethan (Sales Eng): I'll update the internal POC checklist with the hard cap, abort flow, and fallback thresholds.
Kai (SRE): Monitoring active. If sustained p95 >160ms for 3m or errors >1.5% for 5m I'll enact throttling and notify.
Nina (AE): Thanks team, will pass to customer and confirm readiness. :thumbsup:
